source_title: CM gives ex-gratia to people who lost family members in tragic incidents
source_excerpt: New Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Wednesday (October 28, 2026) handed over compensation cheques to families who lost their loved ones in various tragic incidents in the capital. Financial assistance was provided to the family of a COVID-19 warrior who lost her life during the pandemic, as well as to families affected by the building collapse in Satya Niketan, the fire in Tughlakabad and the drowning incident in the Jasola drain, as per the CMO. Financial assistance was provided to the families of the four people who lost their lives in the building collapse in Satya Niketan last month were given an ex-gratia assistance of ₹10 lakh each. Cheques for an ex-gratia amount of ₹5 lakh were also distributed to the family of the person who lost their life in the drowning incident in Jasola. The Chief Minister said the loss of a loved one was irreparable. “In such difficult circumstances, it was the government’s responsibility to stand by the affected families and provide them with all possible assistance. The Chief Minister said that supporting daughters in need at the time of their marriage and standing by them on important occasions in their lives was a sensitive and commendable effort. “Such initiatives provide emotional support to the women and their families while strengthening the spirit of cooperation, respect and belonging in society,” she said.
